title: GOOD MORNING AND THANK YOU ABBA FATHER | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Good morning, Abba Father. Righteous Father, ancient of days, the everlasting God, I come before your throne of grace this morning with a heart overflowing with thanksgiving and praise. I magnify your holy name. For you alone are worthy of all honor, glory, and adoration. You are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. The one who has kept me through the night and has granted me the privilege to see this new day. Hallowed be your name, oh Lord.

I celebrate your faithfulness that has brought me into this moment of divine grace and mercy. This morning opens a new chapter of divine favor, supernatural breakthroughs, and uncommon testimonies in my life. And I decree and declare it so by the authority in the name of Jesus Christ, I align myself with your perfect will and purposes for my existence. I receive fresh mercies this morning. Father, your faithfulness is my confidence and your mercy is my portion.

Your compassions never fail and they are renewed with every sunrise that breaks forth across the horizon. I stand in the reality that your loving kindness reaches beyond the heavens and your truth extends to the skies. I proclaim and establish that I am a child of the most high God redeemed by the precious blood of Jesus Christ. I am not an accident. I am not a mistake. I was fearfully and wonderfully made. Crafted by divine hands with intentionality and purpose.

Every plan you have for me is a plan of hope and a future, not of evil or calamity. Therefore, I walk into this day with divine assurance that I am under your watchful eyes and that your angels are encamped around me. I am secure in your love, protected by your power and sustained by your grace. Aba Father, I thank you. I thank you for the breath in my nostrils. For every heartbeats that pulses with life, for the sound mind you have given me and for the strength in my body.

I thank you that I did not wake up in a hospital bed but in peace and safety. I thank you for my family, my loved ones, and for every blessing you have freely given me. I choose this morning to remember and recount your benefits over my life. I will not forget your goodness, your kindness, your provision, and your protection that have followed me throughout my journey. Divine health is my portion and I decree and declare it with all boldness. By the stripes of Jesus I am healed and I remain healed.

No weapon of infirmity fashioned against my body shall prosper. I command every organ, tissue, cell and system in my body to align with the perfect will of God. I speak life, strength and vitality into my physical frame. My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit and it functions according to divine design. I receive total wellness spirit, soul and body in Jesus's mighty name. Every cell vibrates with resurrection life.

Every system operates at optimal capacity and every organ performs its God-given function with supernatural efficiency. Father, I step into this day under open heavens. Every spiritual the blessing in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus is activated and operational in my life today. The windows of heaven are opened over me. And you are pouring out blessings that I do not have room enough to contain. I receive supernatural supply, divine provision, and overflowing abundance this morning.

My cup runs over with your goodness. My bands are filled with plenty and my vats overflow with new wine. I am positioned for divine encounters with provision that I did not labor for, favor that I did not earn, and breakthroughs that I did not orchestrate. Let every chain of limitation, delay, and stagnation over my life be broken and destroyed right now. I command every satanic embargo holding back my blessings to be lifted by the authority in the name of Jesus Christ.

Father, go before me today and level every mountain standing in my way. Break down every bronze door and cut through every iron bar that the enemy has erected against my progress. Remove every obstacle, dismantle every barrier, demolish every wall, and clear every roadblock that stands between me and my divine destiny. I am walking into open doors that no man can shut. And I am stepping into opportunities that have been ordained from the foundation of the world. You are Jehovah Gyra, my provider.

You are Jehovah Rafa, my healer. You are Jehovah Nissi, my banner of victory. You are Jehovah Shalom, my peace. You are Jehovah Rohi, my shepherd, who leads me beside still waters. You are El Shadai, the allsufficient one who supplies my every need. You are Elleon, the most high God who reigns supreme over all creation. You are Adonai, my Lord and Master who directs my steps. I celebrate you this morning for who you are and for all that you have done in my life.

Abba Father, I honor and magnify your name above every other name. More than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. That is who I am. And I decree and declare it. I am not a victim. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am triumphant. I am not struggling. I am overcoming. The greater one lives inside of me. And because he that is in me is greater than he that is in the world, I walk in dominion and authority today.

I carry the victory of Calvary in my spirit, the power of Pentecost in my soul, and the authority of the kingdom in my words. Every circumstance bows to the name of Jesus that I carry. Every situation yields to the power that operates within me and every challenge crumbles before the faith that rises up in my heart. Let the angelic host of heaven go before me and prepare the way for divine connections, divine appointments, and divine opportunities. I command and release them now.

I activate this promise over my life right now. Angels of the Lord, accompany me today. Minister on my behalf. Clear every obstacle from my path. Open doors that no man can shut and shut doors that lead to destruction. Guard me in all my ways. Bear me up in your hands and make my path straight before me. I am surrounded by a celestial army that responds to the voice of God's word proceeding from my lips. Father, I surrender this day to you.

I present my body as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable unto you, which is my reasonable service. I surrender my plans, my agenda, my desires, and my will to your perfect will. Not my will but yours be done in my life today. Lead me by your spirit into paths of righteousness for your name's sake. I trust you completely Father and I acknowledge you in all my ways today. Take control of every decision I make, every word I speak, every thought I think and every action I take.

Let my life be completely yielded to your sovereign purposes, fully aligned with your divine will and totally submitted to your righteous ways. Supernatural wisdom and divine intelligence are mine today and I receive them by faith. I receive the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Christ Jesus. My mind is illuminated with divine understanding. I will not make mistakes today. I will not miss my way. I will not take wrong decisions. I receive abundant wisdom from above.

Wisdom that is pure, peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. My understanding is quickened by the Holy Spirit. My perception is sharpened by divine insight, and my judgment is calibrated by heavenly wisdom. I navigate this day with the mind of Christ and I make choices that align with eternal purposes. Divine favor surrounds me like a shield today and I decree and establish it. Everywhere I go, I carry the aroma of Christ.

I find favor with God and with men. Doors of opportunity swing open before me. I am helped by grace and I walk in supernatural acceleration. I wear this shield of favor today and it announces me into places of blessing, honor, and promotion. People are supernaturally drawn to assist me. Resources are divinely attracted to my vision and opportunities are magnetically pulled into my sphere of influence. I am a candidate for preferential treatment in the courts of heaven and on the earth beneath.

Every spirit of fear, anxiety, worry, and discouragement is bound and cast down right now in Jesus' name. I refuse to be moved by what I see in the natural realm. I walk by faith and not by sight. For God has not given me a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind. I receive boldness, confidence, and supernatural courage to face this day. I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. My heart is steadfast, my mind is fixed, and my spirit is resolute.

I will not be shaken by reports, moved by circumstances, or intimidated by challenges. I stand firm on the rock of God's promises, immovable in my faith and unshakable in my conviction. Everything I lay my hands upon today prospers, and I decree productivity and fruitfulness over my life. I am a fruitful vine planted by the rivers of water. I am productive, efficient, and effective in all my endeavors. My labor is not in vain in the Lord. A hundfold return on every seed I have sown and will sow today is my portion.

My work produces lasting results. My efforts generate exponential returns and my investments multiply beyond natural comprehension. I am a pipeline of divine productivity, a channel of supernatural fruitfulness, and a vessel of kingdom advancement. No evil shall befall me. Neither shall any plague come near my dwelling. The blood of Jesus covers me, my family, my possessions, and everything that concerns me. I am hidden in the secret place of the most high, and I abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

No weapon formed against me shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. Divine protection and preservation are mine. I am surrounded by the firewall of God's presence, encircled by the fortress of his love and enveloped by the shield of his faithfulness. No arrow of the enemy finds his mark in my life. No scheme of darkness succeeds against my destiny and no plot of the adversary prospers in my territory.

Father, I thank you that you supply all my needs according to your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Financial overflow and economic empowerment are my portion today. I am a lender and not a borrower. I am the head and not the tail, above only and not beneath. I step into divine wealth transfer. The wealth of the sinner is stored up for the righteous. And I positioned myself to receive my portion. Money cometh to me. Resources locate me. Opportunities find me. I am blessed to be a blessing.

My hands are blessed to create wealth. My mind is blessed to generate ideas. And my spirit is blessed to attract divine provision. I walk in the blessing of Abraham. I operate in the prosperity of Isaac. and I flourish in the multiplication of Jacob. Your word, oh Lord, is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path, and I release it over my circumstances. Your word does not return to you void, but accomplishes what you please and prospers in the thing for which you sent it.

Every situation in my life responds to the word of God. I speak to the mountains and they are removed. I speak to the dead areas and they come alive. I speak to the storms and they are stealed. The word of God is alive and powerful in my mouth. Every syllable I utter carries creative force. Every declaration I make releases divine power. And every proclamation I voice establishes kingdom reality.

The sword of the spirit is sharp in my mouth, cutting through confusion, piercing through darkness and dividing between soul and spirit. As Abraham seed and an air according to the promise, I establish covenant blessings over my life. The Abrahamic covenant is operational in my life. The blessings of Abraham are mine. I walk in covenant protection, covenant provision, and covenant promotion. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field.

The fruit of my body, the fruit of my ground, and the fruit of my labor are blessed. I stand in the unbreakable covenant, ratified by the blood of Jesus Christ. I operate under divine guarantees that cannot be nullified by human failure or demonic interference. Every promise of God finds his yes and amen in my life because I am in Christ and Christ is in me. Father, I step into your season of acceleration and I decree and declare it. What would have taken years will happen in months.

What would have taken months will happen in weeks. What would have taken weeks will happen in days. I receive swift answers to my prayers, swift fulfillment of prophecies, and swift manifestation of promises. The Lord hastens his word to perform it. Time is compressed in my favor. Seasons are shortened for my advantage and processes are expedited for my blessing. I am moving at the speed of the spirit, advancing at the pace of grace and progressing at the velocity of divine purpose.

Joel 2:25 is my portion and I command restoration and recovery. I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the crawling locust, the consuming locust, and the chewing locust. Father, everything the enemy has stolen from me is restored. Lost time, lost opportunities, lost resources, lost relationships. I receive double for my trouble, beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. This is my season of recovery and restitution.

What was devoid is replenished. What was stolen is returned. And what was lost is recovered. The thief must restore sevenfold and I am positioned to receive unprecedented recompense for every loss I have suffered. This day is pregnant with divine appointments and I decree divine encounters and supernatural experiences. I will meet the right people at the right time. I will be at the right place at the right moment. My steps are ordered by the Lord. I am sensitive to the leading of the Holy Spirit.

I hear his voice and I obey his prompings. I walk in the supernatural and I experience the manifestations of God's power in tangible ways today. Miracles follow me. Signs accompany me and wonders surround me. I am positioned for strategic connections that will accelerate my destiny. Providential meetings that will unlock my next level and divine alignments that will catapult me into kingdom purpose. Abba Father, I give you all the glory. Everything I am and everything I will ever be is because of your grace.

I boast in nothing except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. I recognize that without you I can do nothing, but with you all things are possible. I am what I am by your grace and your grace upon my life is not in vain. I magnify you. I worship you and I exalt your holy name above every other name. You are the source of my strength, the foundation of my success and the fountain of my supply. Every good thing in my life traces back to your benevolence.

Every victory I celebrate originates from your empowerment and every blessing I enjoy flows from your generous hand. Let your kingdom come and your will be done in my life as it is in heaven. Father, use me as an instrument of righteousness today. Let your light shine through me so that men may see my good works and glorify you. I am a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a peculiar people that I should show forth your praises.

Anoint me to preach good tidings, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and to open the prison doors to those who are bound. Kingdom advancement is my mandate. I am a carrier of your presence, an ambassador of your kingdom, and a representative of your glory. Wherever I go today, let heaven invade earth. Let the kingdom manifest in power and let your will be established on the ground. The peace of God which surpasses all understanding guards my heart and mind through Christ Jesus.

I refuse to let my heart be troubled or afraid. I walk in perfect peace because my mind is stayed on you. The joy of the Lord is my strength and I carry this joy as my inner fortification against every assault of the enemy. Peace and joy I establish in my heart. Regardless of external turbulence, internal tranquility reigns. Regardless of surrounding chaos, inner calm prevails. My emotions are stable. My thoughts are controlled. And my spirit is at rest in the finished work of Christ.

No enemy shall prevail against me today. I am more than a conqueror. And I declare victory over every adversary. I overcome by the blood of the lamb and by the word of my testimony. Every trap set for me backfires against the enemy. Every pit dug for me becomes the burial ground of my adversaries. I am victorious on every side. The battle is not mine but the Lord's. And he always causes me to triumph in Christ Jesus. Every scheme collapses.

Every plot fails and every attack is neutralized by the power of God working in and through me. Health, strength, and vitality flow over every member of my family right now. By the authority given to me in Christ Jesus, I command every sickness, disease, and infirmity to leave my home. My household is covered by the blood of Jesus, and we walk in divine health and supernatural wellness all the days of our lives.

We are protected from pestilence, guarded from plague, shielded from disease, and preserved from affliction. The life of God flows through our bloodstream. The health of heaven saturates our bodies. And the vitality of the spirit energizes our physical frames. Grace upon grace, glory to glory, faith to faith and strength to strength. This is my portion. Your grace is sufficient for me. And your strength is made perfect in my weakness. I step into realms of grace I've never experienced before.

Unusual favor, uncommon wisdom, extraordinary opportunities, and exceptional testimonies are attracted to my life today. Unprecedented grace is mine, and I am a candidate for the exceptional. I am moving into dimensions of divine enablement that I have never accessed, experiencing levels of supernatural assistance that I have never known, and receiving measures of heavenly backing that I have never encountered.

Proverbs 9:10 declares, "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding." Father, grant me a reverential awe of your majesty, a deep respect for your holiness and a passionate commitment to your righteousness. Let me walk in the fear of the Lord all my days. Keep me from presumption, pride, and rebellion. Let my life be a living testimony of your transforming power. I establish the fear of the Lord in my heart.

I honor you with my choices, reverence you with my obedience, and worship you with my lifestyle. My best days are ahead of me, not behind me. I am moving from glory to glory, from strength to strength, from victory to victory. Every day I grow stronger in faith, deeper in love, and more established in the knowledge of God. My tomorrow is brighter than my today. My latter days are greater than my former days. The trajectory of my life is upward and forward. The momentum of my destiny is increasing exponentially.

And the acceleration of my purpose is intensifying dramatically. What I experienced yesterday cannot be compared to what I will experience today. And what I experience today is merely preparation for what I will experience tomorrow. Father, I decree and declare that my voice carries weight in the realm of the spirit. Today, my words are not empty sound, but spiritfilled declarations that shift atmospheres, change narratives, and establish divine order. When I speak, heaven responds. When I pray, angels mobilize.

When I decree, demons tremble. I am not playing religious games or engaging in empty rituals. I am a son of the living God exercising kingdom authority on the earth. My mouth is a weapon of mass construction, building up what the enemy has torn down, restoring what has been devastated, and reconstructing what has been demolished. I command every generational cause working against my bloodline to be broken right now.

Every evil pattern, every negative cycle, every destructive habit that has plagued my family lineage ends with me today. I am a generational covenant breaker and a generational blessing initiator. The iniquity of my fathers will not visit me or my children. I stand in the gap for my lineage and I declare that from this day forward, my family tree produces only good fruit. We are blessed and not cursed, favored and not forgotten, elevated and not relegated to the margins of destiny.

Supernatural debt cancellation is activated over my life today. Every financial obligation that has held me in bondage is being supernaturally dissolved. I decree that creditors are satisfied, bills are paid, loans are cleared, and accounts are settled by divine intervention. Resources are being redirected toward me from unexpected sources. Checks are being written in my favor. Transfers are being made to my account and provision is being released from heaven's storehouse.

I am moving from debt to abundance, from lack to overflow, from insufficiency to more than enough. Let every door that I need to walk through this year swing open by divine mandate. I reject the spirit of almost almost there, almost made it, almost succeeded, almost broke through. I cross over from the place of potential into the place of actualization. Every promise that has been delayed finds its fulfillment in this season. Every prophecy that has been dumb and springs to life in this moment.

Every word spoken over me by true prophets of God begins to manifest with undeniable clarity and supernatural speed. The season of waiting is over. The season of receiving has begun. I declare that my children and my children's children are blessed. They are taught of the Lord and great is their peace. They are world changers, history makers and kingdom advancers. No weapon of miseducation, false ideology or demonic indoctrination prospers against their minds.

They are protected from every evil influence, shielded from every corrupting force and guarded from every destructive relationship. They fulfill their divine assignments, walk in their kingdom purposes, and accomplish their generational mandates. They are mighty in the land and their seed is blessed. Father, I come against every spirit of confusion, delay, and frustration working against my progress. I bind the spirit of the python that constricts and suffocates destinies.

I bind the spirit of Leviathan that creates chaos and twists communication. I bind every marine spirit, every territorial power, and every ancestral demon assigned to my case. You have no legal right to operate in my life. The blood of Jesus has canceled every claim, revoked every access, and nullified every agreement. I evict you from every area of my life, my mind, my health, my finances, my relationships, my career, and my ministry. Get out and stay out in Jesus name.

I receive the spirit of might and supernatural strength today. I am not weak. I am empowered by the spirit of God. I am not tired. I am renewed like the eagle. I am not overwhelmed. I am more than a conqueror. My spiritual muscles are strong. My faith's stamina is unbreakable. And my persistence is relentless. I run and do not grow weary. I walk and do not faint. I press forward and do not retreat.

Every giant I face today is already defeated because the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead lives in me and quickens my mortal body. Let divine alignment manifest in every area of my life. I am aligned with the right people who will propel me into purpose. I am aligned with the right opportunities that will position me for breakthrough. I am aligned with the right information that will give me strategic advantage. I am aligned with the right timing that will maximize my impact.

Everything in my life is falling into divine order. What was out of place is being rearranged. What was disconnected is being reconnected. And what was misaligned is being realigned according to the blueprint of heaven. I decree that my story ends in praise. Every chapter of difficulties working together to produce a testimony that will glorify God and inspire generations. My mess becomes my message. My test becomes my testimony. And my trial becomes my triumph.

People will look at my life and say, "Only God could have done this. My turnaround will be so dramatic. My comeback will be so powerful. And my restoration will be so complete that it will become irrefutable evidence of God's faithfulness, undeniable proof of his power, an incontrovertible testimony of his love. Father, I take authority over this day and I frame it with a word of faith from my mouth. This day will not control me. I control this day through the declarations I make. I set the spiritual temperature.

I establish the prophetic atmosphere and I determine the supernatural outcome through spiritled decrees. Before the sun sets today, I will have testimonies to share, victories to celebrate, and breakthroughs to announce. This is not wishful thinking. This is faithfilled declaration rooted in the promises of God and energized by the power of the Holy Spirit. I bind every spirit of premature death, sudden tragedy, and unexpected calamity. My life is not being cut short. My destiny is not being aborted.

and my purpose is not being terminated. I shall live and not die to declare the works of the Lord. My days are prolonged in righteousness. My years are extended in divine health and my lifespan is maximized according to God's perfect will. I will see my children's children. I will enjoy the fruit of my labor and I will finish my course with joy. I thank you for hearing me. Aba Father, I thank you for answering me. I thank you that before I call, you answer. And while I am yet speaking, you hear.

I trust that every word I have decreed and declared this morning is already in motion, working on my behalf. I release my faith and I walk in confident expectation of supernatural manifestations. I seal this prayer with thanksgiving. The angels have been dispatched. The resources have been released. The doors have been opened. and the breakthroughs have been activated. What I have spoken in the secret place of prayer will manifest in the public place of reality in Jesus name. I decree that this day is blessed.

This week is blessed. This month is blessed and this year is blessed. Every second, minute and hour today works together for my good because I love you and I am called according to your purpose. This day is dedicated to your glory. May my life be a sweet smelling savor unto you. May my words, my thoughts, and my actions bring honor to your name. I yield myself completely to you, Holy Spirit. Lead me, guide me, empower me, and use me for your kingdom purposes. It is done. It is established.

It is settled in the mighty, matchless, all powerful name of Jesus Christ. the name above every other name. In the name at which every knee must bow and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father. Amen and amen. Good morning world. Good morning angels. Good morning to every situation assigned to my life. I step into this day clothed with the whole armor of God, carrying the victory of Calvary and walking in the authority of the kingdom. The Lord is with me and I am with the Lord.

This is the day the Lord has made and I rejoice and I am glad in it. All glory, honor and praise belong to you, Abba Father. From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is to be praised. I give you praise. I give you glory. I give you honor. You alone are worthy. Thank you, Father. Thank you, Jesus. Thank you, Holy Spirit. Good morning and hallelujah. Let the redeemed of the Lord say
